changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: A model call permit carries the band of its call in place of its call class. A permit lives for one call, so each existing permit takes the band of its class: a conversation turn is interactive, a requested, event or composition call is batch, and a scheduled, backfill or product feedback call is background. An unknown class stays unmapped, and the new check then stops the change set. The rule that only a product feedback call has no workspace becomes: a call without a workspace is a background call.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE llm_call_permit DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS ck_llm_call_permit_workspace_by_class

UPDATE llm_call_permit SET band = CASE band WHEN 'TURN' THEN 'INTERACTIVE' WHEN 'REQUEST' THEN 'BATCH' WHEN 'EVENT' THEN 'BATCH' WHEN 'COMPOSITION' THEN 'BATCH' WHEN 'SCHEDULE' THEN 'BACKGROUND' WHEN 'BACKFILL' THEN 'BACKGROUND' WHEN 'PRODUCT_FEEDBACK' THEN 'BACKGROUND' ELSE band END
ALTER TABLE llm_call_permit ADD CONSTRAINT ck_llm_call_permit_band CHECK (band IN ('INTERACTIVE', 'BATCH', 'BACKGROUND') AND (workspace_id IS NOT NULL OR band = 'BACKGROUND'))

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE llm_call_permit DROP CONSTRAINT ck_llm_call_permit_band
UPDATE llm_call_permit SET band = CASE WHEN workspace_id IS NULL THEN 'PRODUCT_FEEDBACK' WHEN band = 'INTERACTIVE' THEN 'TURN' WHEN band = 'BATCH' THEN 'REQUEST' ELSE 'SCHEDULE' END
ALTER TABLE llm_call_permit ADD CONSTRAINT ck_llm_call_permit_workspace_by_class CHECK ((workspace_id IS NULL) = (call_class = 'PRODUCT_FEEDBACK'))
